paper_title: Improved bounds on ultralight scalar dark matter in the radio-frequency range
coupling_convention: g_gamma in eV^-1 (scalar-photon coupling as plotted; NOT converted to dimensionless d_e = g_gamma*M_Pl)
notes: Search for oscillations of fundamental constants (alpha and m_e) from ultralight scalar DM in the 20 kHz-100 MHz (8e-11 to 4e-7 eV) range using Cs optical spectroscopy (Apparatus B measured limit; Apparatus A shown as ultimate/projected sensitivity). Paper constrains BOTH a photon coupling g_gamma (variation of alpha -> ScalarPhoton) and an electron coupling g_e / d_me (variation of m_e -> ScalarElectron), so coupling type is ambiguous; chose ScalarPhoton per hint but confidence is limited. Local DM density rho_DM ~ 3e-6 eV^4 (~0.4 GeV/cm^3, galactic halo scenario; Solar/Earth halos give stronger enhanced bounds). Numerical data only available in log-scale exclusion plots (Fig 2 bottom row for g_gamma), so emitted g_gamma values in eV^-1 are rough estimates read off the galactic-halo Exp B curve, not tabulated. Values NOT converted to standard dimensionless d_e; multiply by M_Pl=2.4e27 eV to obtain d_gamma. | [TEXT-VISION DISAGREEMENT] vision trace differs from the in-range text anchor by 5.0 dex (> 2.0) over the shared mass range — likely wrong curve; deferred to text | selector: text (sole candidate)
